notes.title: Big Update: Beta Build is live!
notes.notes:
Hey, hey. First post!  I'm Felix and I'm the developer of Pool 2! 

For those who don't know, Pool 2 is a game where it's like normal Pool but each player has a cue ball and you can shoot whenever you want, so no more waiting for your turn!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/7eccf94b05e503a0ad66ca81ecffe7cd41e313a7.gif

Over the past month, I've been working hard.  I want to talk about the 3 main things I've worked on.


The new look!

This is Pool 2 the comparison between last month and now:

Game:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/28768f7340d19c4f090223ad41953246e99bac59.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/58da031ffe1571edd90752275859c120bd83c23b.png

Title Screen:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/d3bc52c9498d3080b75bd8a7d1db93defab59cc5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/07812df045d549ef226f4fb6676c3baea68453e1.png

Really big improvement! (I would like to hope...)


New trailer

With the new look comes new store screenshots and trailers so, check it out!

https://youtu.be/bNwu3qtLTU4?si=haxzOsvwGkCHs-Vi


Colour blind mode

Imagine if you're colour blind and you can't play Pool 2. That would suck. Until the last update that is what would happen if you can't see colour.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/d8963013fb784f2f9d3b3f917bdb0d62ebf3a92a.png

Now you can enable colour blind mode in the settings and it will look like this: 

(For people who can't see colour)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/994c6745d65c43c9cbbd41886c21c139bf7e89b2.png

For people who can!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990699/b7810a3db9d73e94d51bb6905c2a52803c1b0486.png

I'm not sure if I know people who are colour blind so if you're actually colour blind do let me know if you can see which balls belong to which group in the comments!


There's a lot more smaller features that I coded over the last month but I'll let you guys find them. I'm going to try and put a demo that stays on this page so you guys can try the game out!

Thanks for reading,

Felix
